thread: Week 2 HSK review quiz: 4 quick questions on this week's grammar and words. Can you score 4/4? Answers in the last post, no peeking. 🧵 #learnchinese #HSK

2/ Q1: Which sentence means "I have been to Beijing (at some point in my life)"?

A) 我去了北京。
B) 我去过北京。

3/ Q2: 今天___冷。(It's a bit cold today.)
A) 有点儿  B) 一点儿

Q3: 请说慢___。(Please speak a bit more slowly.)
A) 有点儿  B) 一点儿

4/ Q4: 东 (dōng) = east, 西 (xī) = west. What does 东西 (dōngxi) mean?

A) a compass
B) a thing, stuff
C) the whole country

5/ Answers: Q1 B, Q2 A, Q3 B, Q4 B.

What was your score? Reply 0 to 4 👇

bonus: Word of the day: 手表 (shǒubiǎo). 手 = hand, 表 = meter, gauge. So what do you wear on your hand to measure time? Reply with your guess, then try: how would you ask "what time is it" in Chinese? #learnchinese #HSK
